metadata.title: Integral of Scalar Curvature: Sharp Asymptotic Bounds and Rigidity
metadata.abstract: For any complete noncompact manifolds $(M^n, g)$ of nonnegative sectional curvature, with $3\le n\le6$, we obtain $\displaystyle \lim_{r\to\infty}r^{2-n}\int_{B_p(r)}\Sc_g\,dV_g\le8\pi\omega_{n-2}(1-\AVR(M^n,g))$ and the corresponding rigidity. The latter bound and its equality classification hold in $(M^n, g)$ with positive-dimensional souls. With a pole, $\displaystyle \lim_{r\to\infty}r^{2-n}\int_{B_p(r)}\Sc_g\,dV_g\le4\pi\omega_{n-2}(1-\AVR(M^n,g))$ follows from an independent distance-sphere proof. analysis.progressType: 标量曲率积分的渐近刚性
analysis.workSummary: 在完备非紧非负截面曲率背景，研究归一标量曲率积分的实际极限；三至六维给出 Euler 特征和渐近体积比控制的尖锐上界及等号分类，有极点与正维灵魂情形得到全维结果。
analysis.breakthrough: 把体积比亏损转为总标量曲率增长的尖锐约束及等号刚性。
analysis.limitations: 已读 PDF 第 1–6 页主定理及路线，补全官方摘要截断的信息。一般尖锐界要求三至六维；闭流形补充结果要求曲率算子至少为恒等，不能替换成单纯截面曲率下界。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 把体积比亏损转为总标量曲率增长的尖锐约束及等号刚性。
